name: milhas-emissao
description: Plataforma de emissão automática de passagens (milhas e dinheiro) — monorepo Angular + NestJS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @milhas/contracts && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w @milhas/contracts
